learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic steps of the business establishment process.
Explains basic concepts related to marketing, production, and management functions.

syllabus_topics: Basic steps of the business establishment process
Entrepreneurial business plan: General information, characteristics of the entrepreneur and the business
Company types, establishment stages, necessary documents in the company establishment process
Entrepreneurial business plan: Market information and marketing plan
Initial investment expenses, fixed-variable operating expenses
Initial investment expenses, fixed-variable operating expenses
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate. The total workload for the course is 83 hours, and the ECTS credit is calculated as 3 based on this workload.
